forensic_audit_metadata.audit_scope: Trace complete chain from original research datasets to final economic verdict

oos_alignment.method: Chronological split with session+timestamp key alignment

r_500_label.method: Strictly future mid-price at t+500ms minus mid at t, scaled to bps

2_exact_sample_size.sample_size_verdict: SEVERELY INADEQUATE - Zero executed trades, zero directional signals

gross_expectancy_calculation.method: mean(sign(prediction) * r_500) across ALL OOS observations (3889 rows)
gross_expectancy_calculation.note: This is DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION EXPECTANCY across ALL observations, NOT executed trade expectancy. The gate threshold is NOT applied.

gated_expectancy_calculation.unit_mismatch_explanation: Model predictions in arbitrary units (max ~0.7 V5, ~3.5 V6), gate threshold in bps (4.6658). No predictions exceed gate.

A_all_observation_directional_expectancy.description: mean(sign(prediction) * r_500) across ALL OOS observations
A_all_observation_directional_expectancy.note: This is DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION EXPECTANCY across ALL observations (including NO_TRADE), NOT executed trade expectancy. HAC p=1.0 indicates NOT statistically distinguishable from zero with proper autocorrelation adjustment.

B_signal_gated_expectancy.reason: UNIT MISMATCH - Model predictions in arbitrary units (max 0.7 V5, 3.5 V6), gate in bps (4.6658). No predictions exceed gate threshold.

C_actual_gross_trade_expectancy.description: Simulated trades using realistic model-unit gate (0.15) to enable execution
C_actual_gross_trade_expectancy.note: Uses model-unit gate (0.15) to enable execution. Gross trade expectancy is positive but tiny (~0.13-0.16 bps).

D_actual_net_trade_expectancy.verdict: NET EXPECTANCY NEGATIVE AT ALL GATE LEVELS AND BOTH COST MODELS. ZERO TRADES PROFITABLE AFTER COSTS.

gross_expectancy_significance.note: Gross directional edge IS statistically significant (p < 0.05) with HAC adjustment. However, this is DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION accuracy, not trade profitability.

net_expectancy_significance.note: Net expectancy NOT statistically distinguishable from zero (p=1.0) because zero trades execute at actual gate.

multiple_testing.note: Gross survives Bonferroni correction, net does not. Deployment gate requires net to pass.

protocol_requirements: Use same frozen V6 model (no refitting)
Run identical Signal Decision Engine gates
Report gross expectancy, net expectancy, HAC p-values

acceptance_criteria.regime_robust: Profitable in at least one non-high-impact regime
acceptance_criteria.long_short_symmetry: Both directions profitable or both non-significant

6_replication_status.note: Protocol requires new untouched Binance data. No independent replication performed to date.

r_500_label_quality.method: Strictly future mid-price at t+500ms minus mid at t, scaled to bps
r_500_label_quality.note: Mid-price changes only 117 times over 25,922 observations. Most r_500 labels are exactly 0, limiting signal resolution.

model_predictions.note: Model outputs are in arbitrary units, NOT bps. Max abs pred ~0.7 (V5) or ~3.5 (V6).

leakage_bias_check.note: Chronological splits with strict future labeling. No look-ahead or survivorship bias detected.

8_v5_vs_v6_comparison.methodology: Identical OOS data (3889 rows), identical horizon (500ms), identical cost model (contemporaneous Q2)
8_v5_vs_v6_comparison.conclusion: V6 adds NO incremental economic value. Gross improvement marginal, CIs overlap, net still zero/negative, incremental R2 = 0.0.

9_governance_verification.config_assert_safe: Raises in live mode without enabled flag
9_governance_verification.runtime_safe_check: Config.runtime_safe() returns False for live mode
9_governance_verification.note: Cannot be disabled without modifying source code

Net expectancy zero or negative after realistic costs at ALL gate levels

V6 adds zero incremental R² over V5 (incremental R² = 0.0)

10_audit_conclusion.data_integrity: VERIFIED - Source data files exist and match reported values
10_audit_conclusion.computation_integrity: VERIFIED - Gross expectancy computed correctly as mean(sign(pred)*r_500) across ALL observations
10_audit_conclusion.discrepancy_explained: Gross expectancy (0.064 bps V5, 0.072 bps V6) is ALL-OBSERVATION DIRECTIONAL EXPECTANCY, NOT executed trade expectancy. Executed trades = 0 because model predictions (~0.7-3.5 arbitrary units) are far below gate threshold (4.6658 bps) due to UNIT MISMATCH.
10_audit_conclusion.executed_trades_zero_reason: Model predictions in arbitrary units (max ~0.7 V5, ~3.5 V6) vs gate threshold in bps (4.6658). UNIT MISMATCH → 0 executions.
10_audit_conclusion.gross_expectancy_interpretation: 0.064 bps is DIRECTIONAL PREDICTION accuracy across ALL observations, NOT trade expectancy. 0 trades executed at actual gate.
10_audit_conclusion.cost_verification: Costs verified from execution_calibration.json and Q2 report. Gate = 4.6658 bps (historical) / 4.6646 bps (contemporary). Break-even = 0.064 bps. Current cost exceeds break-even by 48-73x.
